name: Blue Dragon Arts
text:

natural, and historical sites across Hanoi, we work towards our goal to spread the joy of art.
Through shared experiences in various places and the use different art forms of visual art,

name: Common Threads: Fiber Arts for Good
text:

infants undergoing surgery, dog & cat sweaters for the SNNC pet rescue center, and more!!

engage the UNIS community and partners across Hanoi in our work.

based on our passions and identified opportunities for positive impact. The sky is the limit!
MISSION: To weave community connections one stitch at a time.

curious about knitting, crochet, and/or embroidery (no previous skill required)

name: Cuc Phuong National Park
text:
MISSION: Learn about wildlife conservation work at the Cuc Phuong National Park, and
take action to protect Vietnam’s endangered species in partnership with the Turtle
Conservation Center, Save Vietnam’s Wildlife, and Endangered Primate Rescue Center
(EPRC)
WHAT WE DO
Cuc Phuong National Park, located in Ninh Binh Province, is the oldest and largest national
park in Vietnam. It covers an area of 25,000 hectares across three provinces: Ninh Binh, Hoa
Binh, and Thanh Hoa. This park is a crucial source of biodiversity, home to diverse flora and
fauna.
This group works with Endangered Primate Rescue Center (EPRC), Turtle Conservation
Center (TCC) and Save Vietnam’s Wildlife (SVW) and support those NGOs to promote their
mission to ensure a future for Vietnam’s primates, turtles and small carnivore species.
CUC PHUONG NATIONAL PARK
SOME MAJOR PROJECTS
ESSENTIAL FOR MEMBERS OF THE GROUP
Love of animals & species conservation
Excitement to collaborate with partners
Ability to travel to Cuc Phuong National Park to work with partners and lead visiting
groups (number of trips to be determined by the group and advisors)
Desire to help others learn about Vietnam’s unique ecosystems and how to do their part
to protect them
GRADES 6-8
Developing Educational Materials in collaboration with TCC, EPRC, SVW
Local Turtle Conservation
Organizing & Leading Community Day trips to Cuc Phuong National Park

name: G.O.A.T (Tech Leadership)
text:
UNIS Tech Leadership team is an invaluable resource for supporting students, faculty, staff,
visitors, and families in supporting with technology access and innovation. We assist with
device management, troubleshoot technical issues and ensure that technology is
effectively integrated into the learning process. The tech team offers a unique opportunity
for students to take on leadership roles, support community members, and guide
technology at UNIS.
MISSION: To empower student voices in school technology decision making, elevate school
events with professional live production and technical support, building the next
generation of digital leaders through hands-on service.
WHAT WE DO:
Stage, Stream & Systems Ops: Delivering seamless live streaming, audio/visual
production, light control, and event infrastructure (network and room setups) to
enhance UNIS community events.
Service & Support : Providing dependable, real-time tech troubleshooting and room
readiness for staff, students, and community events.
Student Voice & Leadership : Serving as the voice for technology leadership team,
advising, advocating and communicating technology decision, and mentoring future
student leaders.
ESSENTIALS FOR MEMBERS OF THE GROUP
interest & desire to actively participate in technology decision making, learning new
skills and tech support
willingness to serve as a resource to the community
enthusiasm
passionate about being creative
willing to provide support to at least 2 UNIS events per year, outside of school hours
GRADE 6-12
G.O.A.T (Greatest Of All Tech)

name: Math & Data for Positive Change
text:
GRADE 6-8
MISSION: Provide survey and data analysis to help community members make
positive change.
WHAT WE DO
This group will work with community members inside and outside UNIS to collect, process,
and analyze data with the goal of making a positive impact. The central idea of this group is
“What does the data say?”
Student members will:
Learn mathematical techniques for processing and analyzing statistics
Consult with clients to “ask the right questions”
Learn and use technology to visualize data
Present findings to clients
Engage in the design cycle to improve methods
Deepen their understanding of data privacy

group may choose to pose their own questions and investigate further.

name: Moon & Sun Bears
text:
MISSION: Working towards ending cruelty toward the bears
WHAT WE DO: The Animals Asia Vietnam Bear Rescue Center is located in Tam Dao National
Park, Vinh Phuc Province. It is the first international bear rescue center in Vietnam - a model of
cooperation between Animals Asia, the Vietnamese government and people, with support and
funding from around the world. The 12-hectare rescue center provides lifelong care for more then
200 bears.
Bears live comfortably in bear houses with sleeping rooms that open onto semi-natural areas at
three bear sanctuaries. The bears are cared for, rehabilitated, and enriched, allowing them to live
peacefully and safely. To date, Animals Asia has rescued and cared for more than 700 bears in both
Vietnam and China.
This group works with Animals Asia at Tam Dao Moon Bear Sanctuary and the plight of the
animals; they explore ways to increase awareness of the sanctuary to spark advocacy in our
community and beyond.

Medicinal Plant Nursery

Bear Sanctuary

and Recipe Sharing

ESSENTIAL FOR MEMBERS OF THE GROUP

Excitement to collaborate with partners

ways they can take personal action
GRADES 6-8

name: Plastics Lab
text:
Our purpose is to tackle and provide solutions to the ever growing presence of plastic pollution.
Our current focus areas are design and community education. We reduce plastic pollution by

see plastic as a precious resource that is worth recycling!
MISSION
Close the loop on plastics at UNIS!
We reclaim HDPE & PLA plastics from the UNIS recycling center and make cool stuff with them.
In order to do this, we find out more about community needs around plastics and how we can
innovate to meet those needs with recycled plastic products. This includes...
Helping others learn about plastics as a resource, as well as how to make cool & useful
stuff from reclaimed HDPE & PLA plastics:
workshops
challenges
video tutorials
tools & resources
booths in winterfest, spring fair and other school events.
Building a Plastics Lab!
make use of our recycling center to build an indoor mini grab-and-go library for processed
materials
lead the development of maker-space resources
find out about community needs
partnership with experts in Hanoi (ex/ Red River Recycling), classes, and other service-

mold, stamp, and cut items (ex/ jewellery, keychains, fidgets, coasters, classroom & school

name: Playgrounds & Parks
text:
GRADE 6-8
MISSION: Work with our Hanoi community to create more outdoor spaces to play!
WHAT WE DO
This group will work with ThinkPlaygrounds and other community partners to develop
Hanoi parks and playgrounds like Phuc Tan Forest Park! Through our work and
partnerships so far, Phuc Tan Forest Park has transformed from an illegal landfill to a
vibrant and ecological community space, and important green buffer zone for inner Hanoi.
As this is a HUGE park, we still have lots of opportunity to continue building playgrounds,
play-spaces, outdoor classrooms, and walking trails.
Opportunities include playground design and building, bamboo bridge building, tree
planting, volleyball court development, walking path development, etc.
ESSENTIAL FOR THIS GROUP
Willingness to develop new community and play spaces with Hanoi Youth Union
and Women’s Union.
A passion to support the mission of Blue Dragon and UNIS Hanoi to take responsible
action in the community.
Openness to work with people of diverse backgrounds and perspectives.
Being available to go on 3-4 trips a year, after school.

Design & Installation of Bird Watching Viewers & Bird Guide Signs

Tree Planting & Hiking Trail Development

name: Thuy An Arts Exchange
text:
MISSION : UNIS & Thuy An Center work together to Learn, Teach, and Spread the Joy of Art.
The Thuy An Arts Exchange group aims to spread the joy of art through forms of cultural cooking,
visual arts, and dance. We share our passion for these areas by organizing regular events, projects,
and visits with Thuy An Center - exchanging techniques and passion with each other about how to
cook specific dishes, and exploring different types of art and dancing activities.
Thuy An Center is a public vocational school and top care center for students with disabilities. Most
children at the center are full-time residents, and receive schooling, vocational training, medical
support, as well as physical and occupational therapy on site. The center values education, and many
of the students go on to attend higher education.
Thuy An Arts Exchange group aim to support UNIS & Thuy An students in working together to
develop their passion for the arts and connect communities through the act of sharing art.
ESSENTIALS FOR OUR GROUP
Interest in culinary, performing, and/or visual arts
Excitement about learning together with Thuy An.
Interest in leading small workshops for Thuy An, and
participating in the workshops they lead for us.
Active participation and organization for
collaborative projects with Thuy An (i.e. murals,
dance competitions, cookbooks, etc)
GRADE 6-8
WHAT WE DO
Dance Lessons & Exchange
Learn ASL & VSL! Sign-Language
Classes at UNIS

Art Lesson Exchange & Collaborative
Art Projects

text:

ABOUT OUR WORK
Thuy An Center is a public vocational school and care center for students with disabilities. It
was founded in 1976 as a rehabilitation center for children of war veterans, and has since
developed into the top full-care center for all people with disabilities. Most children at the
center are full-time residents, and receive schooling, vocational training, medical support,
as well as physical and occupational therapy on site. The center values education, and
many of the students go on to attend higher education.
This group helps organize sports exchange activities and projects with hearing-impaired
students in Thuy An Center. Each month Thuy An & UNIS take turns hosting sports
exchanges and continued project development. This groups help develop the health and
well-being of UNIS & Thuy An students by playing sports, and works to develop sports
facilities at Thuy An to support their goals.

at UNIS

name: UNIS Gardens & Pollinators
text:

campus:
tending pollinator and edible gardens
making garden structures like ligns, trellises, bird houses, butterfly coccoon sanctuaries,
and insect hotels to provide extra car4e for our favorite pollinators
indoor & outdoor plant projects
gardening activities & sales at school events
New opportunities come up each year for the group to engage and improve our community
through gardening. In the past, t he group has worked on composting projects, pollinator
